notes.title: Minor update 1.0.1.2
notes.notes:
Small fixes:

 When crafting with a full inventory, the new item will drop to the ground.
 Some melee combat fixes.
 Fixed a bug where the sound of footsteps looped after the death of the character.
 Throwing animation fixes.
